name: pharma-caliper-benchmarks
description: Hyperledger Caliper workloads benchmarking PharmaSupplyChain.sol against local Ganache

scripts.run:initiateTransfer: node scripts/seed.js initiateTransfer 150 && caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/ganache-manufacturer.json --caliper-benchconfig benchconfig/initiateTransfer.yaml --caliper-flow-skip-install --caliper-flow-skip-start --caliper-flow-skip-end --caliper-flow-skip-init
scripts.run:acceptTransfer: node scripts/seed.js acceptTransfer 150 && caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/ganache-distributor.json --caliper-benchconfig benchconfig/acceptTransfer.yaml --caliper-flow-skip-install --caliper-flow-skip-start --caliper-flow-skip-end --caliper-flow-skip-init
scripts.run:dispense: node scripts/seed.js dispense 150 && caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/ganache-pharmacy.json --caliper-benchconfig benchconfig/dispense.yaml --caliper-flow-skip-install --caliper-flow-skip-start --caliper-flow-skip-end --caliper-flow-skip-init
